title: Why did my recharge fail even though the amount was debited?
content:
Question: Why did my recharge fail even though the amount was debited?

Answer: This usually happens due to a bank/payment-gateway timeout after the debit was confirmed but before NovaTel's system received acknowledgement. In most cases the recharge auto-credits within 30-60 minutes. If not credited within 24 hours, the amount is auto-reversed to source; otherwise raise a ticket with the transaction reference.

Topic: Recharge & Payments
